row:
Hi! I'm Dr. Anna Schozer, a small animal relief veterinarian in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, and I share about my life as a veterinarian both on and off shift. My content focuses on vet schol and new-grad guidance, the realities of clinic life, and building a sustainable, fulfilling life beyond the hospital. My goal is to help others thrive in veterinary medicine without losing themselves in the process.

Subscribe to follow along my crazy journey, and maybe learn a thing or two ;)
